Messages.Author: Henrik
Messages.Body:
If a bleed is made unblockable with day op, and then is deflected to my
grandprey, can one of his minion attempt to block (and fail), thus allowing
me to play outferior Psychomachia to cancel the action?
/Henrik Isaksson

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.
Minions that cannot block an action cannot attempt to block the action.
(The ability to generate intercept is not factored into that statement,
however).
